Package swiss.trustbroker.common.util

Class IdmQueryUtil

java.lang.Object
swiss.trustbroker.common.util.IdmQueryUtil

  • Method Details

    • resolveStoreName

      public static String resolveStoreName(swiss.trustbroker.api.idm.dto.IdmRequest idmQuery, String rpId)
      Resolve service/store name from IDMQuery by trying connection attribute first, then falling back to store.
      Parameters:
      idmQuery - The IDM query configuration
      rpId - The relying party ID (used in error messages)
      Returns:
      The resolved service name
      Throws:
      TechnicalException - if neither connection nor store attributes are specified

    • getPlaceholderValues

      public static List<String> getPlaceholderValues(String placeholder, swiss.trustbroker.api.sessioncache.dto.CpResponseData cpResponse, List<Map<String,List<String>>> attributeNameListMap, swiss.trustbroker.api.idm.dto.IdmResult result, String currentStoreName, String undefinedValue)
      Get placeholder values from CPResponse attributes or IDM results.
      Parameters:
      placeholder - The placeholder name
      cpResponse - CPResponse data
      attributeNameListMap - Previous attribute results (from earlier IDM queries)
      result - Current IDM result
      currentStoreName - Current store name (e.g., "LDAP", "REST")
      undefinedValue - Value to use when attribute is not found
      Returns:
      List of resolved values

    • getUserDetails

      public static List<String> getUserDetails(String placeholder, List<Map<String,List<String>>> attributeNameListMap, swiss.trustbroker.api.idm.dto.IdmResult result, String currentStoreName, String undefinedValue)
      Get user details from IDM results based on placeholder. Example placeholder formats: - IDM:REST:employeeNumber - IDM:LDAP:email - LIST:IDM:LDAP:memberOf
      Parameters:
      placeholder - Placeholder string
      attributeNameListMap - Previous attribute results from same store
      result - Current IDM result
      currentStoreName - Current store name (e.g., "LDAP", "REST")
      undefinedValue - Value to use when attribute is not found
      Returns:
      List of resolved attribute values

    • getUserDetailsForSource

      public static List<String> getUserDetailsForSource(swiss.trustbroker.api.idm.dto.IdmResult result, String claimName, String source)
      Get user detail attribute values from IDM results for a specific source.

      Matches claimName against both attribute name and namespace URI, and only returns values where the attribute source equals the provided source (for example IDM:LDAP or IDM:REST).

      Parameters:
      result - Current IDM result containing user details
      claimName - Attribute name or namespace URI to resolve
      source - Source identifier to filter matching attributes
      Returns:
      List of matching values, or an empty list when no match is found

    • getProperties

      public static List<String> getProperties(String placeholder, swiss.trustbroker.api.idm.dto.IdmResult result, String undefinedValue)
      Get properties from IDM result based on placeholder. Example placeholder formats: - PROPS:propertyName - LIST:PROPS:propertyName
      Parameters:
      placeholder - Placeholder string
      result - Current IDM result
      undefinedValue - Value to use when property is not found
      Returns:
      List of resolved property values
